contracts.action: Test helper calls now pass the injected admin-permissions client explicitly: getScopePermissionsResource(client) and createPermission(client, permission)
contracts.equivalent_path: The previous no-argument helpers in AbstractPermissionTest used the same injected `client` field (attachTo ADMIN_PERMISSIONS_CLIENT_ID).
contracts.before_after: Before, the helpers read the `client` field internally. Now the test passes the same `client` field to the static helpers. Behaviour is identical. The static overloads at AbstractPermissionTest.java:62-74 resolve to the same REST calls.
contracts.failure_mode: No new failure path. The overloads do not clash: createPermission(ManagedClient, ScopePermissionRepresentation) differs in arity and type from the other overloads at AbstractPermissionTest.java:163 and :167.

summary: This part is a mechanical refactor of UserResourceTypePermissionTest. The test now passes the injected `client` to the static helpers `getScopePermissionsResource(client)` and `createPermission(client, ...)`. The helpers in AbstractPermissionTest take the same `client` field, so test behaviour is unchanged. I found no issues.
